node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 aggregate norm-gcd compiler
node.statement: For an official m=8 row and P in F_p[X], unit gcd of P with X^(8(p+1))-1 over F_p is equivalent to unit gcds of P with X^(p+1)-zeta for every zeta in mu_8 after base extension. Thus each fixed norm endpoint needs four aggregate prime rows rather than 32 color rows.
node.notes: Exact replay-granularity theorem only. It supplies no gcd verdict; every nonunit aggregate row must be split by norm color and filtered.
